core.title: Grade 1 Tri Packed Door Closer, Dorma 7304ARP689

text.description_html:
Dorma 7304ARP689 Grade 1 Tri Packed Door Closer

The Dorma 7304 door closers offers a sleek modern styling for a new era of safe and reliable door control. These features, along with numerous installation options, make this closer an ideal solution in a variety of applications.

Dorma 7304 door closers are non-handed and have individual adjustments for sweep speed, latch speed, and backcheck cushioning. They are tri packed for regular, top jamb or parallel arm installations. They fit 9-1/16" x 3/4" mounting hole pattern and packaged complete with wood and machine screws.

Features and Specifications for Dorma 7304 Series Commercial Grade 1 Door Closers

  • Fixed Spring Size 4
  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Adjustable back check
  • Aluminum Alloy Shell
  • Horizontal Mounting Holes: 9-1/16"
  • Vertical Mounting Holes: 3/4"
  • Maximum Door Size: 42" interior / 36" exterior
  • Maximum Opening Approx. 180º
  • Finish: Aluminum
  • Tri packed for regular, top jamb or parallel arm mounting
  • Non Handed
  • Meets UL10C for positive pressure
  • UL and CUL listed
  • ANSI/BHMA A156.4 Grade 1 Certified
  • Grade 1 Certified
  • 25 Year Warranty
